text.headline: Timeline of Yemen
text.text: Major events in the history of Yemen.

events.headline: Kingdom of Saba
events.text: Sabaean kingdom prospers through incense and spice trade.

events.headline: Aksumite & Persian Control
events.text: Ethiopia and Persia contest control of southern Arabia.

events.headline: Ottoman Rule
events.text: Ottoman Empire controls parts of Yemen.

events.headline: British Capture Aden
events.text: Aden becomes a strategic British coaling station.

events.headline: North Yemen Independence
events.text: Mutawakkilite Kingdom established after Ottoman collapse.

events.headline: North Yemen Civil War
events.text: Republicans and royalists clash with foreign backing.

events.headline: Unification
events.text: Yemen Arab Republic and PDRY merge to form modern Yemen.

events.headline: Arab Spring
events.text: Protests oust President Ali Abdullah Saleh.

events.headline: Civil War
events.text: Houthi rebels battle the government; Saudi-led intervention ensues.

events.headline: Humanitarian Crisis
events.text: Fragile negotiations seek to end the conflict.
